verdict.rationale: Anthropic's dedicated rate-limits page documents requests per minute (RPM) and tokens per minute (TPM), standard per-tier limit tables, and enforcement semantics (e.g. 60 RPM may be enforced as 1 request per second). Developers can also view their account's limits at /settings/limits and pre-count tokens with the Token Counting API. Missing for 10: any evidence of what a 429 response looks like (error body, retry-after or rate-limit headers), explicit evidence of how tiers scale or advance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
